body.p: Git worktrees let you checkout multiple branches of a repository at the same time, each in a separate working directory. Use worktrees when you need to work on different branches without switching branches or stashing changes.

You can open a worktree in the Git Staging view and work with it like a standard working copy. The Git Client add-on supports existing worktrees, but you cannot create new worktrees directly from the user interface. To create a worktree, use the terminal.
